faults.title: Fragile interior trim and door handles
faults.description: Auto Express says interior trim on the 2008-on 500 can break or fall off, and the seat-tipping mechanism and door handles give trouble, with the handles a particular weak spot.

faults.title: Early clutch failure and diesel flywheels
faults.description: Premature clutch failure isn't rare on petrol 500s. Diesel clutches tend to last longer, but their dual-mass flywheels can cause problems.

faults.title: Parts wearing out early
faults.description: Auto Express says owners' forums report shock absorbers, radiators, wheel bearings, exhausts and air-con compressors failing earlier than expected. It recommends an inspection before buying.

faults.title: Many recalls, including steering
faults.description: The 500 has been recalled 20 times, covering fuel leaks, brakes, airbags, lighting, seatbelts and electrical shorts. The most recent, in September 2022, was for a possible failure in the steering mechanism.
